svg.text: THE LANGUAGE IS JUST THE BEGINNING
Learn the language. Discover the culture. Feel a little more at home.
South to North. Word by word.

text.tspan: new flavors, and a different perspective.

svg.text: A city that never stops saying hello.
Cool mornings, pine forests, and warm conversations.
A little sunshine in every sentence.
Where the mountains meet the sea.
Follow the lanterns into a timeless town.
